prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply llm eval expertise to this task". The fixture contains a plausible happy path, an adjacent-skill decoy, one invalid or partial state, and a recovery condition that must be demonstrated rather than assumed. The acceptance boundary is llm-evaluation: Define the decision the evaluation supports, task distribution, slices, baseline, success rubric, grader independence, contamination controls, and statistical uncertainty. The adjacent computer-vision discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

blind expert labels spanning clear pass/fail and hard semantic-boundary examples

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual llm-evaluation boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=data-analysis,testing-engineering; near-neighbor=computer-vision), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define the decision the evaluation supports, task distribution, slices, baseline, success rubric, grader independence, contamination controls, and statistical uncertainty.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Run candidate and baseline on the same held-out cases, inspect disagreement and failure slices, calibrate automated graders against blind human review when consequential, and persist raw artifacts and revision identities.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not report one aggregate score without slices, let the author grade its own intended answer, change prompts and test cases together without a holdout, or hide invalid/incomplete runs.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Versioned task population, immutable holdout, provenance/slices and contamination controls; Comparable candidate/baseline model, prompt, tool, retrieval, environment and retry configuration; Deterministic outcome checks plus calibrated independent semantic graders with disagreement evidence; Repeated-trial raw artifacts, uncertainty, invalid-run accounting, slice results and regression ledger), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
